title: Qayamat aayi na
body:
shaam ki qaid mein saydaniyan aseer hui
rasool zadiyan haakim ki dastageer hui
<<DIVIDER>>
qayamat aayi na kyun kibriya zamane mein
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke sayyed e sajjad khoon rote thay
naseeb e waqt ne dikhlaye marhale kaise
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
qayamat aayi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
zameer mar gaye insan ke dil huwe patthar
ye imtehan bhi kaisa hai khaaliq e akbar
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
qayamat aayi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye keh ke aankh se zainab ne ashk barsaye
jhuka jo sar mere bemaar ka sabab ye hai
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
qayamat aayi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ki aal ye ghurbat ye bekasi maalik
ke kaayenat fana kyun na hogayi maalik
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
qayamat aayi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam ye kaisa hai ehsaas to karo logon
yazeedi mehel mein charcha ye hogaya dekho
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
qayamat aayi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar apna peet liya jab khabar ye paayi
janabe hind ke kaano mein jab khabar aayi
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
qayamat aayi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
lehed mein khaak udaane lage habeeb e khuda
gayi jo shaam se yasrab talak kisi ki sada
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
qayamat aayi na...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mazhar abidi phir kuch bhi likh nahi paaya
wo shadman ke honton pe marsiya aaya
ali ki betiyan aayi hai qaid khane mein
qayamat aayi na...
author: Mazhar Abidi
